preconditions.description: The number of BubbleCores N is between 3 and 15,000 inclusive.
There are exactly N lines of electrical wiring.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= U < N and 0 <= V < N and U != V for U, V in wirings)
preconditions.description: Each wiring connects two distinct BubbleCores U and V within the range 0 to N-1.

postconditions.description: The output is the maximum sum of all BubbleCores' potentials.
